text:
Priya: Heads up — drafting the customer-facing notes for next week's staggered maintenance windows. Plan is 3 waves: NA -> EU -> APAC, each a 2hr window with a 30m buffer. Putting the statuspage + email copy below, please +1 or suggest edits.

Alex K.: Thanks — can we add a note about 'no data loss' and link to the rollback runbook? customers always want that line.

Priya: Good call. I'll add a short rollback line. Also thinking of adding a small FAQ line about Dedicated pinning behavior (we'll pin to v2.3.1 for the window). Thoughts?

Jin: Pinning note is important. Suggest: "Dedicated customers: your pinned model versions will remain untouched; infrastructure changes won't auto-upgrade pinned slots." Short and explicit.

Kate: +1 to both. Also: can we surface expected degraded throughput vs full outage? Some customers expect SLO-level numbers. Maybe: "Possible transient latency increases; we expect 20-30% reduced throughput for ~10-20 minutes after restart" — is that accurate?

Priya: Yes that's accurate for the NA wave. I'll keep it conservative: 20-40% reduced throughput for up to 30m post-restart.

Alex K.: For the statuspage snippet, can we keep it succinct. Here's a draft: 

```
Status: Scheduled Maintenance (rolling)
Window: NA: 2024-11-12 02:00–04:00 UTC, EU: 2024-11-12 06:00–08:00 UTC, APAC: 2024-11-12 12:00–14:00 UTC
Impact: Temporary latency increases and short capacity reductions (20–40%) during restarts. No data loss expected. Pinned Dedicated model versions are not auto-upgraded.
Action: Operations will perform staged restarts with canary validation. Customers can contact support for exceptions.
```

Priya: Nice. I'll paste that into the statuspage editor. For email subject line: `Planned maintenance: rolling infrastructure upgrades — Nov 12 (UTC)`

Jin: Suggest adding a sentence on fallback behavior: "Requests may be automatically routed to alternate regions or compatible model variants if capacity constrained." Useful to set expectations.

Priya: Added. Full email body draft below — feel free to trim: 

```
Hi <customer>,

We will perform a rolling maintenance on Nov 12 to apply infrastructure and runtime updates. This will occur in three regional windows (NA, EU, APAC). During restarts you may see temporary latency increases and reduced throughput in affected regions. We expect no data loss and will preserve any customer-pinned model versions.

If your workload requires strict throughput during the windows, reply and we will discuss options (dedicated reserved time, temporary rerouting, or job rescheduling).

We will post live updates on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai and reach out when each regional wave completes.

Thanks,
Redwood Support Team
```

Kate: Looks good. Can we add an ops contact line (pager or rotation)?

Priya: Ops contact: `eng-oncall@redwood.ai` and paging for severe regressions. Adding now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created in statuspage (ID: evt-20241112-001). Publication set to manual; use `/status-publish evt-20241112-001` when ready.

Alex K.: Quick checklist before we publish: 1) Confirm canary smoke tests for each region 2) Run preflight `kv-cache` snapshot 3) Ensure rollback runbook link is included 4) Notify top 10 customers individually (support to own)

Jin: I'll own #2 and #1 (will kick off smoke tests 1h before each window).

Priya: I'll do the top-10 list and coordinate the individual emails. Kate will own the statuspage publish after we confirm.

Kate: Got it. Will queue the publish and do a quick QA in the staging statuspage.

Alex K.: Last ask — add a short line in the statuspage about SLO impact (we're not changing SLOs but transparency helps). e.g., "No SLO changes expected; short latency/throughput impacts during restart windows."

Priya: Added. If there are no further comments I'll publish to staging and loop back here once it's ready for final publish. :thumbsup:

Kate: Staging copy checked — minor grammar tweak. Ready for final when you are.

Priya: Publishing to staging now, will post link in this thread when live.

deploy-bot: Statuspage staging URL: https://status.staging.redwood.ai/incidents/evt-20241112-001

Priya: Link up — please review and then we can send the email & publish.

Alex K.: Reviewed, LGTM. Support, please prepare the customer email send list and templates.

Jin: Smoke tests queued for NA wave (T-1h).

Kate: Final QA done. Ready to publish to public at T-15m.

Priya: Thanks all. I'll hold final publish until T-15m and post the go/no-go here.
